svg.title: /ticket-loop
svg.desc: A photocopied newspaper front page. Masthead: slash ticket hyphen loop. Headline: Ticket worked until done, autonomously. Three columns describe the skill, beside a halftone picture of a loop.

g.text: ONE TICKET, FROM PLAN TO DONE

text.font-family: TLHead, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', Times, serif

g.text: Approve the plan once. The agent does the rest, step by step, and no one asks what is next.

text.tspan: Approve the plan one time, and the
ticket is worked until it is done.
The agent reads the ticket and the
code, and it writes the plan before
Then it works every step on its own:
branch, fix, test, PR, review, and
QA. A checklist page shows each step
as it happens, live in the browser.
When it tries to stop early, a Stop
hook sends it back to the next step.
It never merges. It lets go when
something breaks, or when it is

g.text: FIG. 1: The loop. It ends when the ticket is done.
